title: Require Domain Operation Strategy Source Topology
forbids: domain operation strategy directories without one canonical barrel and semantically named kebab-case strategy modules
why: Strategy filenames preserve selectable behavior identity. Closing current domain-root strategy directories removes generic default.ts identities and alternate helper surfaces while TypeScript and the operation SDK own strategy registration, key binding, and default inference.
remediate: Keep index.ts plus semantically named kebab-case strategy modules directly under an operation's strategies directory. Rename default.ts from the strategy's behavior, then update its createStrategy id, contract key, operation binding, and consumers together.
message: Domain operation strategies must use the positive strategy blueprint source topology.
